caption: The drawing depicts a square piece of fabric or textile positioned in the center of a plain, off-white background. The textile pattern consists of a grid composed of vertical and horizontal stripes in varying widths and colors, primarily featuring blue, brown, and off-white. The blue and brown bands intersect at regular intervals, creating a plaid or checked pattern across the textile. The center and some other rectangular sections are lighter, dominated by off-white, and the entire pattern is characterized by a weave-like texture, with visible “threads” or linear marks indicating the woven construction. The edges of the textile are straight and the pattern is regular and symmetrical, repeating in both horizontal and vertical directions. Near the bottom left corner of the off-white background, the name "MAGNUS S. FOSSUM" is faintly stamped in uppercase letters.
title: Handwoven Coverlet
cluster: #22 — Domestic Textiles: Coverlets, Tablecloths, and Rugs
